dogecoin.text:
The vast majority of $HOGE holders hold #dogecoin 

Between what Doge has done in these last few days + HOGE’s huge listing on @BigONEexchange this Friday, I sense a lot of this account’s followers will be smiling by the end of the week!

Using #dogecoin’s rise to comprehend $HOGE ‘s potential:

One day, HOGE’s supply will become more scarce than Doge.  But its current MC of $138 million is 170x less than where Doge sits right now.

HOGE only needs ~1/6 of Doge’s MC to hit .01c as soon as *THIS* year! That’s 3k%!

What #dogecoin is doing is truly inspiring. It is the trailblazer for meme currency. I don’t just say this as a doge holder: the patient are gaining what they deserve!

While there are a lot of copycats, don’t forget who the trailblazer for tokenomic meme currency is.. 

$HOGE
